</blockquote></div><div></div></div></div></div></div></section></div></div></section><section tabindex="-1"><div><div></div><div></div></div><div><div><section><div><div></div><div></div></div><div><div><div><div></div><div></div></div><div><div><div><h1><span><span><span>Yacht options</span></span></span></h1></div><div><p><span><span>The choice of yacht is individually tailored to the trip, group size and desired experience.<br><br> Regardless of size, catamarans offer a high level of comfort and are ideal for private cruises focused on kitesurfing and wing foiling. The twin hulls guarantee maximum space: there's ample storage for all your equipment and generous deck space for launching and landing kites, as well as setting up wing foil boards. Our standard catamaran for shared cruises is a Lagoon 42. Larger models, such as the Fountaine Pajot 51 or Lagoon 60, offer more space, additional lounge areas, and increased privacy. The size of the boat significantly impacts the price.</span></span></p>
<p><span><span><span></span></span></span></p>
<p> <span><span>Single-hulled sailing yachts are recommended exclusively for private trips where kitesurfing is possible but not the main focus of the trip.</span></span> board</span></span></h2></div></div></div></div><div><div><div></div><div></div></div><div><div><div><p><span><span><span><span>The catering is fully organized, so no elaborate planning or shopping is necessary beforehand.</span></span></span></span><br></p>
<p> <span><span>Breakfast is varied and balanced, with a mix of sweet and savory options such as eggs, avocado, fresh bread, vegetables, cold cuts, jams, honey, muesli, and regional specialties – occasionally complemented by little extras like fresh pancakes.</span></span> <span><span>Lunch focuses on light, healthy dishes, ideal for active days on the water – for example, fresh salads with chickpeas or lentils, wraps, or crispy tarte flambée.</span></span> <span><span>In the evenings, everyone cooks and eats together on board: simple Mediterranean dishes like pasta or risotto, or a relaxed BBQ under the stars, round off the day.</span></span><br></p>

<p> <span><span>✗</span> <span>Alcoholic beverages</span></span></p>
<p> <span><span>✗</span> <span>Travel insurance</span></span><span><span><span></span></span></span><span><span><span></span></span></span><span><span><span><span></span></span></span></span><span><span><span></span></span></span><span><span><span></span></span></span><span><span><span></span></span></span><span><span><span></span></span></span> <span><span><span><span></span></span></span></span><span><span><span></span></span></span> <span><span><span><span></span></span></span></span><span><span><span></span></span></span></p>
<p></p>
<h3> <span>Payment terms</span></h3>
<h3> <span><span><span><span><span></span></span></span></span></span></h3>
<p> <span><span><span><span><span>✓</span></span></span></span></span> <span><span>&nbsp;</span> <span>Down payment: 50%</span></span></p>
<p> <span><span><span><span><span>✓</span></span></span></span></span> <span><span>&nbsp;</span> <span>Final payment: due 8 weeks before the start of the trip</span></span></p>
<p> <span><span><span><span><span>✓</span></span></span></span></span> <span><span>Bank transfer or PayPal</span></span></p></div></div></div></div></div></section></div></div></section><section tabindex="-1"><div><div></div><div><wow-image><img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/ffa35e_50054ebcdbad4bcab9a074ba0341351a~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_72,h_39,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,blur_2,enc_avif,quality_auto/ffa35e_50054ebcdbad4bcab9a074ba0341351a~mv2.jpg" alt="untitled-64.jpg" width="980" height="259"/></wow-image></div></div><div><div></div></div></section><section tabindex="-1"><div><div></div><div></div></div><div><div><div><h2><span><span><span><span><span>Do you have any further questions?</span></span></span></span></span></h2></div><div><div><div><div><div dir="ltr"><div></div><div><div><div><button><div><div><div><div><h3>What is the difference between a shared trip and a private charter?</h3></div><div></div></div><div></div></div></div></button><div><div><div><div><div><div dir="ltr"><div><div><p dir="auto" tabindex="-1"><span><strong><span>Shared Trip:</span></strong></span></p><p dir="auto" tabindex="-1"><span><span>You&#x27;ll travel together with other participants on a boat. Perfect if you&#x27;re booking alone, as a couple, or in a small group of friends and want to meet new people. The group usually bonds very quickly, and by the second day it feels like we&#x27;ve known each other for ages!</span></span></p><div dir="auto" tabindex="-1"><span><br/></span></div><p dir="auto" tabindex="-1"><span><strong><span>Private Trip:</span></strong></span></p><p dir="auto" tabindex="-1"><span><span>You book the entire boat exclusively for your group – for example, with friends, your team, or your family. The route, pace, and daily schedule are individually tailored to your wishes.</span></span></p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div></div></div><div><button><div><div><div><div><h3>Who are private cruises suitable for?</h3></div><div></div></div><div></div></div></div></button><div><div><div><div><div><div dir="ltr"><div><div><p dir="auto" tabindex="-1"><span><span>Private cruises are ideal for groups of friends, families, company off-sites, incentive trips, birthdays, or anyone who wants to enjoy maximum flexibility and privacy.</span></span></p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div></div></div><div><button><div><div><div><div><h3>Can we choose the route ourselves on a private cruise?</h3></div><div></div></div><div></div></div></div></button><div><div><div><div><div><div dir="ltr"><div><div><p dir="auto" tabindex="-1"><span><span>Yes. The route will be planned together with you and can be adapted to your wishes as well as the current wind and weather conditions.</span></span></p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div></div></div><div><button><div><div><div><div><h3>Can non-kiters participate in a private cruise?</h3></div><div></div></div><div></div></div></div></button><div><div><div><div><div><div dir="ltr"><div><div><p dir="auto" tabindex="-1"><span><span>Yes, of course. Many private groups consist of a mix of kiters, wing foilers, sailing enthusiasts, and guests who simply want to enjoy life on the water.</span></span></p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div></div></div><div><button><div><div><div><div><h3>Is there a minimum age for participation?</h3></div><div></div></div><div></div></div></div></button><div><div><div><div><div><div dir="ltr"><div><div><p dir="auto" tabindex="-1"><span><span>Private charters are available for families with children of all ages. We do not accept children under 12 on shared trips. We recommend that teenagers be accompanied by a parent or guardian.</span></span></p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div></div></div><div><button><div><div><div><div><h3>Are there age restrictions?</h3></div><div></div></div><div></div></div></div></button><div><div><div><div><div><div dir="ltr"><div><div><p dir="auto" tabindex="-1"><span><span>There is no fixed upper age limit. What&#x27;s important is that you are healthy enough for life on board and the planned activities.</span></span></p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div></div></div><div><button><div><div><div><div><h3>Are private cruises also suitable for families?</h3></div><div></div></div><div></div></div></div></button><div><div><div><div><div><div dir="ltr"><div><div><p dir="auto" tabindex="-1"><span><span>Yes. Private cruises are a fantastic way for families to spend time together on the water and customize their trip. Children are very welcome! Upon request, we also offer kiteboarding lessons for children, provided they meet the necessary requirements.</span></span></p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div></div></div><div><button><div><div><div><div><h3>Can we, as a company, book a private cruise?</h3></div><div></div></div><div></div></div></div></button><div><div><div><div><div><div dir="ltr"><div><div><p dir="auto" tabindex="-1"><span><span>Yes. Many companies use our catamarans for incentives, team off-sites, workations, or client events. The trip can be individually tailored to your goals. If the sailing location isn&#x27;t your main focus, we recommend our partner, The Sailing Hub. They offer events and retreats that prioritize other activities.</span></span></p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div></div></div><div><button><div><div><div><div><h3>Can we book additional activities for a private cruise?</h3></div><div></div></div><div></div></div></div></button><div><div><div><div><div><div dir="ltr"><div><div><p dir="auto" tabindex="-1"><span><span>Our trips are individually tailored to your wishes in advance. We will discuss your food preferences and your ideas for activity planning with you.</span></span></p><div dir="auto" tabindex="-1"><span><br/></span></div><p dir="auto" tabindex="-1"><span><span>Whether it&#x27;s diving, island visits, wing foiling, snorkeling, freediving, wakeboarding, hiking, restaurant visits or special requests – that&#x27;s exactly what we&#x27;re here for.</span></span></p><div dir="auto" tabindex="-1"><span><br/></span></div><p dir="auto" tabindex="-1"><span><span>Most activities are already included in our all-inclusive package. Should we need to partner with one of our companies for certain experiences, such as diving excursions, we will inform you transparently about any additional costs and plan everything together with you.</span></span></p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div></div></div><div><button><div><div><div><div><h3>On which yachts do the trips take place?</h3></div><div></div></div><div></div></div></div></button><div><div><div><div><div><div dir="ltr"><div><div><p dir="auto" tabindex="-1"><span><span>Our shared trips typically take place on a Lagoon 42 (or similar). We tailor private charters to your specific needs. You&#x27;ll receive a quote from us with various options and a presentation of the yacht choices, allowing you to decide which yacht is best suited for you and your group.</span></span></p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div></div></div></div></div><div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></section><section tabindex="-1"><div><div></div><div></div></div><div><div><section><div><div></div><div></div></div><div><div><div><div></div><div></div></div><div><div><div><a href="mailto:info@kite2sail.com?subject=Special%20Questions" target="_self"><span><span>Chat with us!</span><span><span>
